name: Farhad Ali
title: Business Administration Student | Supply Chain, Logistics & Operations
bio: I am a Business Administration student at Sacramento State with plans to concentrate in Supply Chain Management. I am also completing an AS-T in Business Administration at San Joaquin Delta College, expected December 2026. My experience spans regulated manufacturing, inventory management, team leadership, and e-commerce order fulfillment.
whoami: I’m Farhad Ali, based in Lodi, California. I bring hands-on experience in manufacturing, logistics coordination, inventory control, and daily operations, and I’m building toward a career in supply chain management.
currently: Studying Business Administration at Sacramento State and completing my Business Administration AS-T at San Joaquin Delta College. I am seeking internships and entry-level opportunities in supply chain, logistics, procurement, inventory management, production planning, global operations, and international business.
mission: My goal is to help teams keep materials, inventory, and orders moving efficiently. I want to build on my manufacturing and operations experience to improve planning, reduce waste, and support reliable supply chains.
status: Seeking supply chain, logistics, and operations internships and entry-level opportunities.

experience.title: Manufacturing Associate I — Production & In-Process Testing
bullets: Operated MCAL, VBA, GX, and other equipment during 12-hour shifts in a regulated GMP and ISO environment.
Used SAP to verify materials, lot status, expiration dates, and production approval; coordinated material issues with Logistics.
Performed in-process testing using GeneXpert systems, documented results in Excel, and coordinated follow-up with Quality.
Moved and allocated production materials and coordinated testing priorities to support production schedules.
Trained more than 30 employees on equipment, procedures, quality requirements, and safe work practices.

experience.title: E-Commerce Seller
bullets: Managed Shopify and eBay storefronts and fulfilled more than 250 customer orders.
Created listings, set prices, sourced products after purchase, and coordinated shipments through delivery.
Reviewed demand and listing performance and communicated with customers about orders.
